steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; window.__clear=()=>{const w=g.env.weather; w.cloud=w.cloudTarget=0.1; w.rain=w.rainTarget=0; w.timer=99999;}; __clear(); g.env.day=2; g.env.setTime(2.6); const p=g.world.place('observatory'); g.player.place(p.x, p.z, p.face); __rhf.settle(); window.__view=(id)=>{g.env.update(0, g.camera.position); g.screens.scopeSel=id; if(!g.screens.current) g.screens.open('telescope',{tab:'scope'}); else {g.screens.tab='scope'; g.screens.render();} return id+': '+(document.getElementById('eyecap')?.textContent || document.querySelector('.scope-off')?.textContent)}; return 'night 2 at 02:36'})()
